Aurelith Forge — Free Fantasy RPG Inventory, Shop & Crafting UI Starter Pack
Publisher: NexaVisuals
Release model: Free / Pay What You Want

WHAT THIS IS
Aurelith Forge is a fantasy RPG inventory, shop and crafting UI starter / reference pack. It is designed to help indie developers, cozy RPG creators, visual novel creators, game jam teams, pitch deck creators and UI artists move faster when planning item-management flows.

This is a structured visual direction and prototype asset pack. It is not a PSD, Figma, Unity, Unreal or Godot project.

WHY IT IS FREE
This is a free launch release from NexaVisuals. It is intended to build trust, help indie creators, collect early feedback and support future product updates. Donations, ratings and comments are appreciated but not required.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
- 12 high-resolution UI / layout / reference screens as PNG
- 60 RPG inventory/item icons as PNG 512x512
- 60 RPG inventory/item icons as PNG 256x256
- 60 SVG open-format alternatives for icons
- 12 modular transparent PNG overlays
- 6 background panels / parchment / frame assets
- 3 ready-to-show mockup compositions
- design_tokens.json
- local HTML/CSS preview page
- marketplace copy and documentation

RECOMMENDED USES
- Moodboarding and visual direction
- Game pitch decks
- Early RPG UI prototyping
- UI layout studies
- Visual novel reward, inventory and shop concepts
- Game jam mockups

LIMITATIONS
- Not an engine-ready implementation
- No PSD, Figma, Unity, Unreal or Godot source files included
- Not a complete coded UI system
- Some assets are reference/prototype-oriented rather than final production widgets

FORMATS
PNG, SVG, JSON, HTML, CSS, TXT, Markdown.

START HERE
Open Product_Files/HTML_CSS_Preview/index.html in your browser to browse the pack locally.
